description: Paid work, projects, formal study (university), meetings. Legacy 'Work / Study' explicitly mixes work and formal study, so current Education items that are formal study are mapped here.
Self-directed courses, reading, journaling, podcasts. Split from WORK_STUDY is judgement-based in the current taxonomy; compare the PRODUCTIVE block when in doubt.
Email, banking, investing, shopping, habit/time trackers, errands. Phone 'Productivity & Finance' and 'Shopping & Food' app buckets are mapped here with REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Messaging apps. Apple Screen Time's generic 'Social Networking' bucket cannot be split between messaging and feeds and is NOT mapped here (see DIGITAL_SOCIAL_UNSPLIT).
Streaming, video, games, TV, social feeds.
Apple Screen Time generic 'Social Networking' category (messaging + feeds mixed). Exists only in the current system. Compare at the DIGITAL_LEISURE_AND_SOCIAL block level.
Sleep, workout, meditation, health apps, spiritual reflection.
Family and friends time recorded manually in both regimes.

Legacy standard allocation for eating, bathroom, shower (and nap from Nov 2025). The current system does not record this; the equivalent time sits inside the inferred Off-Device residual. Compare only DAILY_LIVING_AND_RESIDUAL.
Legacy 'Vacations' row used to fill vacation days towards 24 h (Jan and Apr 2026). Activity is unspecified; the current system would show such time as Off-Device residual.
ActivityWatch system processes and Apple Utilities / Screen Time / Other buckets. No legacy equivalent (legacy transcription did not record system time).
ActivityWatch 'Uncategorized' time (split 50/50 between Productivity & Finance and Utilities by the current classification weights).
No defensible bridge group. Preserved, never silently assigned.
